title: Where a twist can enter a count: the local factorization, walls and symmetries
claim: On every closed orientable surface with a cellularly embedded graph, the number of orientations whose cyclic edges are exactly a given skeleton factorizes, in a given twist, as c times A: c counts the orientations of the skeleton in which every skeleton edge is cyclic, and depends only on each twisted cluster up to switching; A counts the acyclic orientations of the cover of the graph with every cluster shrunk to a point, where an odd cluster has a single node, so twists on edges at it do not enter. Parallel edges of the shrunken graph and series edges of a cluster can be merged without changing the factors. Hence two twists whose series-reduced clusters and parallel-reduced shrunken graphs are isomorphic up to switching give equal counts, skeleton by skeleton. The boundary circles of a cluster's neighbourhood span exactly the radical of its lattice, so every twist in the mod-2 span of the duals of the radicals of a label's odd clusters preserves that label's count (the wall group, extending the lone-loop wall to clusters of any rank); automorphisms of the tiling act on twists and labels; and on the L-shaped genus-2 tilings planar duality relates no two counts of one surface.
failure_conditions: A (twist, skeleton) pair of L(2,1,2,1) whose count differs from c * A, or whose c or A changes under the reductions.
A random cluster whose boundary walks do not span exactly the radical of its lattice, or whose corner edges do not form a cocycle of class PD.
A count of L(2,1,2,1) changed by an automorphism of the tiling or by an element of its label's wall group.
foundation_claim_scope: Twisted double covers of uniform random orientations on closed orientable surfaces with cellularly embedded graphs; exact factorization and relation statements. Lattices and surfaces are declared; no space or physics is claimed.

validation.status: checked: prose proof; check.py (standard library) enumerates all 2^16 orientations of L(2,1,2,1) in all 16 twists and on 120 sampled (twist, skeleton) pairs confirms the factorization N = c A, the series and parallel reductions, and c = T(0,2), A = T(2,0) of the frame matroids by brute force; every automorphism (1600 relations) and every wall-group element (236 relations) preserves the counts of L(2,1,2,1); on 338 random clusters of three larger surfaces the boundary walks span exactly the radical and their corner edges form cocycles of class PD; on odd clusters the dual of a boundary class keeps the label and both factors; the tilings' degrees are {4, 12}. Four controls rejected. No human or external review
